jobs.title: Cashier, SM Bacolod
jobs.description: We are looking for a Cashier to serve as an important control point in the completion of each customer purchase. This position will be reporting to work at SM Bacolod. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Merchandise Verification and Packing Verify that all merchandise presented for payment has been correctly recorded in the transaction. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM South Mall
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This position will be reporting to work at SM South Mall . You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Selling-Floor and Merchandise Standards Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and presentation of assigned selling areas. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ensure

jobs.title: E commerce Account Specialist
jobs.description: Summary We are looking for an E-commerce Account Specialist to manage and monitor our online presence across various e-commerce platforms, including Shopee, Lazada, Zalora, and Shopify. Your responsibilities will extend to coordinating closely with the Marketing and Merchandising Planning and Control Department to ensure alignment between online sales strategies and overall business objectives. This is an onsite position at Armal Compound 2, M. Eusebio Avenue, San Miguel, Pasig City. Roles and responsibilities Manage and maintain e-commerce platforms to showcase latest trends and collections, optimizing product titles, descriptions, and imagery. Partner with Marketing to align our online sales strategies with the captivating campaigns they craft. Collaborate closely with our Merchandising Planning and Control Department to ensure our online assortments are in sync with our offline offerings, creating a seamless shopping experience for our customers. Analyze performance data to uncover actionable insights that refine promotional calendars and product assortment. Resolve customer inquiries with empathy and efficiency to create memorable and meaningful experiences and build brand loyalty for Fashion Fusion Bring collaborative spirit, working closely with cross-functional teams like Store Operations, Fulfillment, and Customer Service to ensure our online operations run smoothly. Share your knowledge and insights with your teammates, fostering a culture of continuous leaming and growth. Perform other related duties and functions as assigned by the company.

Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. jobs.description: Decathlon Philippines is committed to a strategic, multi-year expansion initiative to better serve our customers across the region! To accompany this fast development, we are looking for a Real Estate Business Developer to develop, execute and manage business development projects leading to a profitable and sustainable growth for Decathlon within a dedicated zone/region. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop Local Expansion Strategy Define the vision and strategy for Decathlon's development (including stores and other formats) within the territory to increase market share. This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines. jobs.title: Marketing Events Associate
jobs.description: Adarna House is in need of a highly organized, meticulous, and communicative Activations Lead who loves storytelling. This role is similar to a project manager in that you will manage Adarna House events and marketing partnerships to create meaningful experiences for our readers. You will work with a Creatives team and a Digital Marketing team to plan, promote, and execute various on-site brand activations. Responsibilities include: Marketing Event Execution Plan concept and execution of various events including but not limited to book fairs, workshops, and book launches. Execute activities within a predefined budget by proposing budget, and canvassing suppliers and vendors. Manage all aspects of Adarna House’s live storytelling service including storyteller deployment, assessment, and training. Be responsible for event outcomes including attendance rate and participant satisfaction. Partnerships Management Manage brand collaborations and partnerships. Be a point person for representing Adarna House’s marketing team to external partners and clients. Maintain a positive relationship with external collaborators such as Adarna House book creators, content creators, storytellers, and various brands & organizations. Team Coordination Be a project lead for marketing events including assigning event roles, tracking and distributing project budget, and communicating with other departments. Lead the continuous improvement of events and partnerships executions, including creating event reports and running post-mortem meetings. You will succeed in this role if you can Be entrusted to execute an on-site event from start to finish with full accountability. Maintain healthy communications with several overlapping internal and external collaborators, keeping everyone in the loop. Both comfortably client-face and confidently rally colleagues.

jobs.title: Equity Sales Trader
jobs.description: Main Responsibilities: The Equity Sales Trader is responsible for executing trades, maintaining and expanding client relationships, and supporting sales and trading operations. This role demands exceptional attention to detail to ensure accurate trade execution, precise account maintenance, and strict compliance with regulatory requirements. The Equity Sales Trader must be able to work independently during trading sessions and handle high-frequency, high-volume transactions without compromising accuracy or the Best Execution Rule under the SRC (Securities Regulation Code). The position also requires strong public speaking skills, the ability to confidently address clients or stakeholders—even on short notice—and at least basic knowledge of research and analysis. The ideal candidate is committed to continuous learning, open to enrolling in all necessary studies, courses, training, and workshops, and willing to obtain and pass any additional licenses required in the future. Flexibility to work in both hybrid and full on-site arrangements is also required. Duties and Responsibilities: Execute, maintain, and grow relationships with house accounts, institutional accounts, retail accounts, and done-through accounts. Proactively engage in relationship‑building activities, including attending industry and social events with institutional and high‑net‑worth clients. Provide meticulous execution support to traders, sales agents, and their clients, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Act as the primary point of contact for CAIF (Customer Account Information Form) updates for the Traditional and Institutional Sales Team, with careful attention to completeness and correctness. Serve as the sales liaison for accreditation renewals and applications, ensuring all documentation is properly prepared and submitted. jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description: Job Summary Art Directors at SlideGenius are responsible for intake, oversight, and creative leadership toward successful project outcomes. They possess exceptional attention to detail, strong written communication skills, and a deep passion for design principles. While their expertise spans overall design, their experience in creating PowerPoint presentations is unparalleled. Art Directors manage written client communications—providing clear, professional updates, feedback, and creative direction to ensure alignment with client goals. This position functions as a bridge between project management, design teams, and clients, ensuring projects are executed with precision, efficiency, and design excellence. Duties/Responsibilities: Art Direction Brainstorm, suggest, critique, and demonstrate design and layout concepts that exemplify SlideGenius design standards. Translate written or recorded client feedback into actionable design direction. Provide clear, concise written communication to align the design team with client needs, even when project requirements shift unexpectedly. Client Communication (Written Only) Draft professional, well-structured client communication that guides creative conversations and clarifies design direction. Lead creative discovery activities through written correspondence, early-stage briefs, reviewing recorded calls, and internal pre-design planning. Maintain consistent, timely communication with clients through project updates and written correspondence. Design Facilitation Conducts thorough quality control reviews of all designer outputs before client delivery, ensuring art direction is followed, brand standards are upheld, and client expectations are met. Guide and mentor designers to uphold high creative standards, ensure client satisfaction, and achieve optimal project outcomes.
